bug.title: Science check-only and CSSwitch updater behavior are not closed
bug.summary: The product issue distinguishes Science check-only behavior from the CSSwitch updater path; their selection, identity, and failure boundaries are not claimed closed by this node.

steps: Compare the check-only path with updater candidate selection in an isolated fixture.
Record executable identity and failure behavior without reading real Science data.
reproduction.observed: The issue is registered as open; no updater, installed, or live Science result is asserted here.

confirmed_facts.statement: The requirement registry keeps the Science check-only path and CSSwitch updater selection as separate concerns.

hypotheses.statement: An invalid or mismatched candidate may be accepted or rejected at the updater identity boundary; the current target has not been run.
